name: Mridangam Juke Syllables
desc: FUSES South-Indian mridangam strokes (perc.world.darbuka/mridangam family) with footwork's 160 triplet chatter (perc.footwork.ratchets): tha-ki-dhin syllables rattle the juke grid like a konnakol battle at the roller rink.

code.full: stack(s("mridangam_tha ~ mridangam_ki mridangam_tha ~ mridangam_ki mridangam_dhin ~").speed(${tone}).gain(${gain}), s("~ mridangam_nam ~ ~ mridangam_thom ~ ~ mridangam_nam").speed(${tone}*1.1).gain(${gain}*.75)).shape(.4).ply("<1 1 ${burst} 1>").lpf(6000).pan(sine.range(.4,.6).slow(9)).every(8, x=>x.rev()).orbit(2).play()
code.peak: stack(s("mridangam_tha mridangam_ki mridangam_tha mridangam_ki mridangam_dhin mridangam_ki mridangam_tha mridangam_thom").speed(${tone}).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.7,${gain}).fast(4)), s("~ mridangam_nam ~ mridangam_dhum ~ mridangam_thom ~ mridangam_nam").speed(${tone}*1.15).gain(${gain}*.8)).shape(.45).ply("<1 ${burst} 1 [${burst} 4]>").lpf(7000).pan(sine.range(.32,.68).slow(6)).lastOf(4, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(2).play()
